items.html: Indeed, Netzach, though it is the right line, is not corrected first, because it is the phase of the legs, and also because it is bound with Hod, as stated in the discourse, ‘Along with the thorn, the caper bush is struck’ — said regarding Netzach and Hod, that they are not fully clarified until the time of nursing, when, from being blood, they turn into milk, and ZA nurses; then they finish being corrected. See there.
